title: Embedded integral coefficient maps and predicates
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite intermediate field E of PadicAlgCl ell, an element pi in its embedded integers, and a scheme X in universe u. Define discreteSheaf and discreteObj by constant sheafification with ULift of scalar rings. Define constantToContinuous by sending scalars to constant continuous functions, discreteMap by sheafifying ring homomorphisms, scalarPointMap and scalarMap by this map for the embedded integers and inverse image to X, and residueMap by the first principal-ideal quotient. restriction is exact termwise derived scalar restriction. complete is the existing ConstantCompletion.IsComplete predicate on the equivalent small section-ring site; completedComplete and constantComplete use respectively the completed and constant first quotient maps. residueConstructible requires constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude of derived constant first reduction. stacksConstructible is constantComplete together with that residue condition. integralModelResidueEtaleOrigin is finiteness and discreteness of the actual residue quotient together with membership of the intrinsic realization of the completed first reduction in the essential image of the bounded constructible etale comparison. All ring structures and maps are constructed; none is selected from a mere existence theorem. These are the original definitions of sk-lem-integral-models, extracted without changing their types or data, together with the abbreviation of the residue conjunction as residueConstructible.
